ValidationRule.description: Blocks PHOCS Admin and Officer users from creating or updating Child Care and Residential Care investigation Cases outside their authorized Health Authority.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.EHISBypassValidationRuleCustomPermission), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PHOCSComplaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PHOCSReportableIncident' ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Topic__c, "Child Care"), ISPICKVAL(Topic__c, "Residential Care") ), NOT( OR( AND( OR($Permission.PHOCSAdmin, $Permission.PHOCSOfficer), ISPICKVAL(Account.HealthAuthority__c, 'Fraser Health - FH'), $Permission.PHOCSFHAChildCareResidentialCareAccess ), AND( OR($Permission.PHOCSAdmin, $Permission.PHOCSOfficer), ISPICKVAL(Account.HealthAuthority__c, 'Interior Health - IH'), $Permission.PHOCSIHAChildCareResidentialCareAccess ), AND( OR($Permission.PHOCSAdmin, $Permission.PHOCSOfficer), ISPICKVAL(Account.HealthAuthority__c, 'Northern Health - NH'), $Permission.PHOCSNHAChildCareResidentialCareAccess ), AND( OR($Permission.PHOCSAdmin, $Permission.PHOCSOfficer), ISPICKVAL(Account.HealthAuthority__c, 'Vancouver Coastal Health - VCH'), $Permission.PHOCSVCHChildCareResidentialCareAccess ), AND( OR($Permission.PHOCSAdmin, $Permission.PHOCSOfficer), ISPICKVAL(Account.HealthAuthority__c, 'Island Health - Island'), $Permission.PHOCSVIHAChildCareResidentialCareAccess ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to create or edit a Case for this Health Authority.
